s.note: Peter learning Lara Jean's favourite Korean yoghurt drink
s.how: Blend 300g Greek yoghurt with 300ml cold milk, 2 tbsp honey and a squeeze of lemon until smooth and drinkable. Pour into small bottles and chill well. Shake before drinking, a favourite snack on the school bus.

Melt 150g dark chocolate. Dip 20 marshmallows halfway and roll the chocolate end in crushed peppermint lollies. Set on baking paper for 20 minutes. Pack them for the school ski trip, especially the hot tub bit.

m.note: Lara Jean's dad cooking Korean food for the girls
m.how: Slice 600g beef rump thin and marinate in soy, grated pear, crushed garlic and sesame oil for an hour. Sear hot in batches. Serve with jasmine rice and cucumbers tossed with salt, chilli and a little vinegar as quick kimchi.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar, an egg and a teaspoon of vanilla. Mix in 225g flour and 150g dark chocolate chips. Roll into balls and bake at 180C for 10 minutes until soft in the middle. Pile them on a plate.

d.how: Mash 300g strawberries with 4 tbsp sugar and stand 15 minutes. Spoon into 4 glasses, add ice and top with 250ml cold milk each. Stir before drinking.
